title: Società Benefit in Puglia — a journalist who found the model through Incorruptible reports from Foggia
summary: Di Matto, a growth lead and journalist, says she discovered Italy's Società Benefit model through the book. She reported from a Foggia session of Puglia's regional programme promoting the form, noting that IT and software is Italy's most benefit-incorporated sector and that median EBITDA margins match conventional firms.
blockquote: L'innovazione tecnologica e la protezione della missione aziendale (come insegna Eric Ries nel modello di Anthropic) viaggiano di pari passo.
